passages.text: IEG reports productive assets remaining in use at 86%, below the revised 95% target. Some beneficiary totals include double counting; reported Konna benefits lack supporting data. Independent desk-based ICR validation; retrospective project evidence. Historical Mali reconstruction project, including Konna/Mopti. No counterfactual attribution; no automatic transfer to current actors, communes or 2026 needs. Source ICR quality rated High, while some outcome indicators remain limited.

passages.text: IEG rates outcome Moderately Satisfactory and efficiency Modest.
